evals.prompt: In my nixos-config repo, override the existing nixpkgs package podman-compose to a specific upstream commit because I need a merged PR that is not in unstable yet. Put the change in overlays/ and use a fake hash if you cannot know the real one.
evals.expected_output: Creates or updates an overlay that uses the repository-specific flake-aware signature, overrideAttrs, fetchFromGitHub, and lib.fakeHash for the source hash.
expectations: The overlay uses `{ flake, ... }:` before `final: prev:`.
The overlay modifies an existing package with `prev.<pkg>.overrideAttrs` instead of creating a new package under packages/.
The changed source uses `lib.fakeHash` when the real hash is unknown.
The response mentions a build/evaluation command to obtain and verify the real hash.

evals.prompt: I have three local patches for cockpit-zfs and want an overlay directory that applies everything under patches/. Please follow the conventions in this repo rather than listing every patch manually.
evals.expected_output: Creates an overlays/<name>/default.nix style overlay that imports rabit-lib from flake.inputs.self and appends rabit-lib.findPatches ./patches to existing patches.
expectations: The solution uses an overlay directory with `default.nix` for patch assets.
The solution does not edit flake.nix to register the overlay manually.

evals.prompt: Patch a KDE package inside kdePackages and add a wrapper to one binary. I do not want a new top-level package; it should affect pkgs.kdePackages.<name> in this repo.
evals.expected_output: Uses a scoped override for kdePackages with clearly named inner final/prev variables, preserves old attributes when appending inputs or hook text, and uses makeWrapper correctly.
expectations: The solution overrides `prev.kdePackages` with `overrideScope` rather than exposing only a new top-level package.
The inner package-set arguments are named distinctly from top-level `final` and `prev`.
The hook text preserves existing hook content when appending behavior.
